output.title: New `iss` short name for Issuer reaches this cert-manager install
output.content: The release notes list this only as a feature: the cert-manager `Issuer` resource gets the `iss` short name (ev-38243747b200). This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 (label, flux-helmrelease, argocd-application, helm-annotation and helmfile sources) and uses `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate`, so the upgrade to v1.18.0 delivers this change. The CRD inventory only shows `certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]` and the crds dimension is marked absent, so it can't be confirmed whether the Issuer CRD is installed or managed here. Check whether the Issuer CRD is part of this install, and whether any other CRD in the cluster already uses the `iss` short name, so `kubectl get iss` resolves to the resource you expect.
